name: SwimSchoolLevelProgressTracker
tagline: Assess swimmers on poolside, see who is ready to move up and issue certificates – a complete learn-to-swim app for Power Apps.
description: A plug-and-play learn-to-swim progression app in one PCF control. Teachers tick skills per class in a skill grid (or one swimmer at a time on a phone), the app checks readiness (skills, weeks in level, attendance), suggests the next-level class with free places, plans and confirms class moves and issues level certificates. Built-in Stage 1–7 framework or your own levels and skills. Works with canvas collections and data sources, model-driven views and Power Pages.
features: Class skill grid with whole-class column ticks and 'seen today'
Readiness rules: skills %, minimum weeks, minimum attendance
Drag to the next level to plan a class move
Capacity, level and venue checks for moves
Confirm moves with automatic level certificate
Search, quick filters, filter drawer, sort, group, bulk actions, CSV export
